summary: Open per-study and per-meta-analysis tables on inbreeding depression exist on Dryad (CC0), but those found are restricted (polyploids; one beetle species; mate-choice across animals), and none were opened to verify columns. No open compilation was found that holds outcrossed-versus-inbred fitness across many plant and animal species together with between-variety crosses; COMPADRE has no cross-type field and MaizeGDB returned 403.
next_step: Open the xlsx/xls files listed (e.g. meta_analysis_ID.xlsx) to confirm column names, and look for the source meta-analyses (e.g. Crnokrak and Roff; Charlesworth and Willis) for their supplementary tables.
obstacles_confirmed: No single open database spans taxa; compilations are published experiment by experiment.
Outbreeding depression at large genetic distance is a known counter-case in the scope.
